competition: Rajasthan Royals SupeRR Selector Season 2 — Round 1

formal_estimand.question: Which players provide the strongest evidence of reliable positive execution under pressure for the specific role and context relevant to Rajasthan Royals?
formal_estimand.primary_expectation_specification: Specification B (Exogenous macro match state, excluding recent-12-ball player outcomes)
formal_estimand.pressure_opportunity: Continuous match state intensity P(t^-) in [0, 1]
formal_estimand.clutch_estimand: Descriptive context-adjusted pressure differential (Multi-dimensional coarsened exact matching)

remediated_attribution_rules.batter_runs: Strictly runs off bat (excludes byes, leg-byes, wides, penalties)
remediated_attribution_rules.bowler_runs_conceded: Bat runs + wides + noballs (excludes byes, leg-byes, penalties)
remediated_attribution_rules.bowler_wickets: is_bowler_wicket == 1 (excludes run-outs, retire out, obstructing field)
remediated_attribution_rules.retired_hurt_handling: Medical/injury stoppage (zero wickets charged to team or bowler)

uncertainty_model.name: Lower Uncertainty Bound (LUB / conservative lower bound)
uncertainty_model.distributional_approximation: Empirical Bayes shrinkage with normal quantile approximation
